_comment_source: SLAMTEC RPLIDAR A2M8, the sensor on the physical VICA. Isaac 6.0.1 ships profiles for HESAI, NVIDIA, Ouster, SICK, SLAMTEC (RPLIDAR_S2E only), Velodyne and ZVISION -- there is no A2, so this file exists to stop the simulator modelling a 30 m S2E where the robot has a 12 m A2.
_comment_install: Register the folder holding this file, then create the lidar with config 'RPLIDAR_A2M8'. Isaac resolves profile names against app.sensors.nv.lidar.profileBaseFolder (see extsDeprecated/isaacsim.sensors.rtx/config/extension.toml). Either append this directory to that setting, or copy this file into isaacsim/extsDeprecated/isaacsim.sensors.rtx/data/lidar_configs/SLAMTEC/.
_comment_verify: Ranges and rates below are datasheet figures for the A2M8 and have not been checked against the unit on the robot. The A2M12 variant differs (0.2 m minimum). Confirm against /scan on the real robot before treating sim-to-real range behaviour as validated: ros2 topic echo /scan --field range_min --once (and range_max).
name: RPLIDAR A2M8

profile._comment_range: 0.15 - 12.0 m rated. config/vica_2d.lua and the AMCL block filter from 0.2 m so the same numbers hold for an A2M12; the sensor model stays at the A2M8 figure.
profile._comment_accuracy: A2 accuracy is quoted as a percentage of distance (about 1% under 3 m, rising to 2.5% at 12 m) rather than a constant. RTX takes a single figure, so 0.03 m approximates the mid-range case.
profile._comment_resolution: 8000 samples/s at 10 Hz is 800 points per revolution, an angular resolution of 0.45 deg. These two numbers are what set angle_increment and rate on /scan, so they matter more to Nav2 and cartographer than anything else in this file.
